effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: Negate the effect of any Spell Card that targets this card and destroy it. As long as this card remains face-up on the field, you can add 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monster from your Deck to your hand per turn instead of drawing 1 card from your Deck during your Draw Phase. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the GOAT script's draw-replacement search adds no Level 4 or lower Warrior, it reveals the Deck to prove the whiff (else-branch Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK) in s.operation); the modern script simply ends the resolution. No lineage version carries reveal wording.

changes.summary: Era activation semantics, separate from the verification procedure: the GOAT s.target returns true unconditionally where the modern script requires Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,...), so the player may give up the normal draw for the turn (the EFFECT_DRAW_COUNT 0 replacement is still registered) with no eligible Warrior in the Deck - a real cost paid for nothing. No source in the packet dates the end of this per-card allowance, so its chronology is unresolved.

review.notes: Baseline text matches lineage v2 (DB2-EN137, Dark Beginning 2, 2005-07-27) exactly; v2's printing postdates the 2005-04-01 GOAT snapshot, but its only difference from v1 (LOD-EN016, 2003-06-06) is "designates this card as a target" -> "targets this card" plus "from your Deck", both cosmetic, and v2 is the text in force for Edison. Trailing lineage v3 (RP02-EN054, 2009-07-24), v4 (BP01-EN123, 2012-05-24) and v5 (SBCB-EN149, 2020-11-26) are PSCT passes preserving the resolution. PACKET CONFLICT: the pinned modern cdb text matches no lineage version exactly (modern_text_matches_version = v5 at ratio 0.81) and self-describes as "unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG"; recorded as seen rather than reconciled. Script divergences beyond the two ruling edits look like upstream staleness, not era encoding, and none of them was found to change a resolution: the EFFECT_DISABLE field effect uses SetTargetRange(0xff,0xff) in the GOAT copy against LOCATION_SZONE,LOCATION_SZONE modern (the companion EFFECT_SELF_DESTROY effect e3 still uses the narrow S/T-zone range in both, and an activated or equipped Spell sits in the S/T Zone either way), s.distg lacks the modern nil-target guard c:GetCardTargetCount()==0, s.disop tests re:IsActiveType(TYPE_SPELL) rather than re:IsSpellEffect(), and RESET_PHASE|PHASE_DRAW is written with +. The upstream GOAT script also carries the annotation "If revived by premature burial, not destroyed", recording the era ruling that a Freed revived by "Premature Burial" does not negate and destroy it. Upstream ships one GOAT script encoding both ruling behaviours, so no implementation exists for a state in which only one had changed, and with (B) undated the pair cannot be sequenced. Not listed on EdisonFormat.com's Functional Errata page.
